selected.title: He Planned a Move Abroad Without Telling Me
selected.hook: My boyfriend applied for a job overseas and forgot to mention that our relationship wasn’t part of the plan.
selected.voiceover:
My boyfriend applied for a job overseas and forgot to mention that our relationship wasn’t part of the plan.

We’d been together for three years and had just renewed our lease. We talked about saving for a bigger place, maybe getting a dog, all the normal future stuff.

Then his laptop lit up while he was making dinner.

The notification said, "Final interview confirmed — relocation package attached."

I thought it had to be spam.

It wasn’t.

He’d applied for a job in another country six weeks earlier, made it through two interviews, and never told me.

When I asked why, he said he didn’t want to "stress me out over something that might not happen."

Fair enough, until I asked what would happen if he got the offer.

He paused and said, "I’d probably take it."

Not "we’d talk about it."

Not "would you come with me?"

Just: "I’d take it."

Then he said long distance could work and we could "figure us out later."

That was the part that hurt.

He’d spent weeks planning a possible new life while I was making decisions based on the future we supposedly shared.

Now he says I’m treating a career opportunity like a betrayal, and that he shouldn’t need permission to apply for a job.

I agree he doesn’t need permission.

But after three years together, do you owe your partner a conversation before quietly planning a life in another country?
selected.youtube_description:
She thought they were planning their future together until one laptop notification revealed her boyfriend had been interviewing for an overseas job for six weeks. Is applying for a career opportunity a personal decision, or does a serious relationship require that conversation before the final interview?
